name: cr701_20_visibility_brainstorm_put_back_unseen
why: CR 402.3 / 401.2: Brainstorm draws into its caster's own hand and puts two cards back with no reveal or look, so it opens no reveal window: the opponent never sees the put-back cards, and only the caster's own Ponder then looks at them (step 1 T1 reveal windows, --trace-visibility)
expect_order: ^Player A puts Force of Will to top of library
^Player A puts Daze to top of library
^VISIBILITY: open look Daze in library of A at 0 to A
^VISIBILITY: open look Force of Will in library of A at 1 to A
